drafts.reply: On-chain usefulness does not give the token Fedwire finality. Holders still rely on the issuer to convert the token back into an actual Treasury.
Fee accrual to the token still decides upside after a product ships. Historically, live networks still left the token worthless when usage never hit the asset.
Cooled ETF inflows shift the burden onto existing holders, so a hold in the mid-$80ks after the push toward $87k does not by itself restore the bid.
